description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command: export SRC=/gt/_work OUT=/gt/_out WORK=/gt/_work CC=clang CXX=clang++ SANITIZER=memory FUZZING_ENGINE=libfuzzer LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE='-fsanitize=fuzzer' CFLAGS='-O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins' CXXFLAGS='-O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins' && rm -rf /gt/_out && mkdir -p /gt/_out && source /gt/oss_fuzz_setup.sh && cd /gt/_work/src && bash /gt/oss_fuzz_project/build.sh
